title: Data and code for "Underpaid professors and world-leading firms: academic pay stagnation as a plausible force behind the flow of research talent into Korean industry"
description: Compiled aggregate figures (professor salaries, large-firm employee and executive pay, business R&D, researcher counts, HBM market shares, CPI), variable definitions, and a Python script that reproduces every derived figure in the manuscript. All values are transcribed from published sources cited in the article; no individual-level or restricted data.
